description: Shared-build prerequisite, root dev scripts, and the complete MongoDB-backed Express API in the empty server/ workspace: env/secrets loading with append-if-missing, Mongo singleton + typed collections + GridFS, JWT auth, public reads + assembled GET /api/league, protected CRUD writes with whitelist discipline, PDF reports via GridFS, and an idempotent seed with admin bootstrap. Independent of FEAT-002 at the code level (server is self-contained) but MUST land first because the client refactor consumes this API contract and because building @bowling/shared here unblocks all later type-checks.
steps: Run `npm install` at the repo root, then `npm run build --workspace=shared` so shared/dist/index.d.ts exists (hard prerequisite for every tsc -b). In root package.json add `"predev": "npm run build --workspace=shared"` and rewrite `"dev"` to `"npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client"`; leave dev:server, dev:client, build, seed unchanged.

Create server/package.json: name @bowling/server, private, "type":"module"; scripts dev=`tsx watch src/index.ts`, build=`tsc -b`, start=`node dist/index.js`, seed=`tsx src/seed.ts`; dependencies @bowling/shared:*, express ^4, mongodb ^6, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, multer, dotenv, cors; devDependencies tsx, typescript, @types/express, @types/cors, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/bcryptjs, @types/multer (versions per design.md). Create server/tsconfig.json mirroring design.md: ESM, moduleResolution bundler, declaration, composite:true, outDir ./dist, rootDir ./src, strict, skipLibCheck, esModuleInterop, include ["src"], references [{ "path": "../shared" }]. Create server/src/types.d.ts with a global `declare namespace Express { interface Request { user?: { username: string } } }` and NO top-level import/export. Run `npm install` at root to link the new workspace.

Implement server/src/env.ts per design.md: dotenv.config({ path: '../atlas-credentials.env' }); typed ServerConfig { mongoUri, dbName, jwtSecret, adminUsername, adminPassword, port } with NO username/password fields; append-if-missing for DB_NAME=bowling_league, JWT_SECRET=crypto.randomBytes(48).toString('base64url'), ADMIN_USERNAME=admin, ADMIN_PASSWORD=crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('base64url'); detect existing keys by reading the raw file once and testing /^\s*KEY=/ per non-comment line (never overwrite/re-quote); append bare `\nKEY=value` via fs.appendFileSync and set process.env; use MONGODB_URI verbatim (dotenv already stripped quotes), never interpolate credentials; fail fast if MONGODB_URI or JWT_SECRET missing; log key NAMES only, never values; port = Number(process.env.PORT) || 4000.

Implement server/src/db.ts per design.md: single MongoClient; connectDB(uri) connect+ping, getDb(), closeDB(); import { ObjectId, GridFSBucket, type Collection, type Db } from 'mongodb' and all @bowling/shared as `import type`; doc types TeamDoc/BowlerDoc/ScheduleDoc/ResultDoc/LeaderboardDoc/AdminDoc/LeagueMetaDoc and ReportMetaDoc = Omit<WeeklyReport,'id'> & { _id?: ObjectId; gridFsFileId: ObjectId }; typed getters for league_meta, teams, bowlers, schedule, results, leaderboards, admins, reports_meta, plus getReportsBucket() (bucketName 'reports'); generic `function stripMongoId<T extends { _id?: ObjectId }>({ _id, ...rest }: T): Omit<T,'_id'> { return rest }`; ensureIndexes() creating UNIQUE indexes on teams.id, bowlers.id, schedule.week, admins.username.

Implement server/src/auth/middleware.ts (extract Bearer token, jwt.verify, set req.user={username}; 401 for missing/malformed/invalid) and server/src/auth/routes.ts (POST /login: validate non-empty username/password, bcrypt.compare vs admins, identical 'Invalid credentials' 401 for unknown-user or bad-password, sign { sub: username } with 7d expiry, return LoginResponse { token, user:{username} }; GET /me behind middleware returns AdminUser).

Implement server/src/routes/league.ts: GET /api/health -> {status:'ok'}; assembleLeague() with six parallel reads (leagueMeta().findOne({}), teams, bowlers, schedule sorted {week:1}, results, leaderboards with NO .sort()), 503 if no meta, mapped through stripMongoId into the exact League shape; GET /teams, GET /teams/:id (by domain id, 404), GET /bowlers, GET /schedule, GET /results, GET /leaderboards each stripping _id.

Implement protected write routes behind the auth middleware with whitelist discipline (never spread raw body): server/src/routes/teams.ts, bowlers.ts, schedule.ts, results.ts (CRUD), leaderboards.ts (PUT full-replace via deleteMany({}) then ordered insertMany, accept value:number|string, preserve insertion order), leagueMeta.ts (PUT whitelists {season,currentWeek,currentWeekDate,split} via replaceOne({},...,{upsert:true})). Identity keys immutable on PUT: strip id/_id (teams,bowlers), week/_id (schedule), _id (results) from $set; URL param authoritative. POST uniqueness pre-checks -> 409. Results validation EXACTLY per design/task: week positive int; lanes non-empty string; homeTeamId/awayTeamId non-empty strings; homeGames/awayGames arrays of numbers>=0, MAY be empty and MAY differ in length; homeSeries/awaySeries numbers>=0 NOT required to equal game sums; homePoints/awayPoints numbers>=0. Results PUT/DELETE by _id hex (400 on bad hex). Proper status codes.

Implement server/src/routes/reports.ts per design.md: multer memoryStorage, limits.fileSize=10*1024*1024, fileFilter accepts only application/pdf, field name 'file'. POST /api/reports (JWT, chain [upload.single('file'), handler] multer-first): require file + season/week/date, open GridFS upload stream, write buffer, await finish, insert ReportMetaDoc (gridFsFileId, form fields, uploadedAt ISO, sizeBytes, filename, contentType), on metadata-insert failure delete the orphaned GridFS file, return 201 toWeeklyReport(doc). GET /api/reports (public) lists WeeklyReport[] sorted {season:1,week:1} via toWeeklyReport (the explicit 8-field mapper — never stripMongoId). GET /api/reports/:id (public) streams PDF with Content-Type:application/pdf and Content-Disposition:inline. DELETE /api/reports/:id (JWT) deletes GridFS file + metadata, idempotent, 204.

Implement server/src/index.ts + bootstrapAdmin: run env, connectDB, ensureIndexes, bootstrapAdmin (insert admin from ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD bcrypt-hashed cost 12 only if none exists); express(), cors(), express.json({limit:'1mb'}) as the SOLE JSON parser; mount all /api routes; global error handler mapping MulterError (LIMIT_FILE_SIZE->413, LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE->400, else 400) and all else ->500 (never log secrets); app.listen(config.port); SIGTERM/SIGINT -> closeDB.

Implement server/src/seed.ts by copying the league data VERBATIM from client/src/data/league.ts into plain objects typed with @bowling/shared (import type): 6 teams, 18 bowlers, 3 schedule weeks, 3 results (keep awaySeries:0, single-element awayGames, differing array lengths exactly), 4 leaderboards (two titled 'High Average', groups Male then Female), meta season '2026 Lakers', currentWeek 3, currentWeekDate '2026-09-23', split 'Split 1 (Weeks 1 - 16)'. Flow: load env, connect, DROP the seven collections, insertMany each, bootstrapAdmin, disconnect, exit. Review copied values against the original before deleting anything (FEAT-002 deletes the client source). Do NOT delete client/src/data/league.ts in this feature — FEAT-002 owns that deletion.

Write server/README.md: env vars (names only), scripts, full endpoint list, and that the admin password lives in the root atlas-credentials.env under ADMIN_PASSWORD (never print the value; never put the Atlas password in the README).
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` at root succeeds and shared/dist/index.d.ts + shared/dist/index.js exist after `npm run build --workspace=shared`.
Root package.json has predev=`npm run build --workspace=shared` and dev=`npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client`; build/seed/dev:server/dev:client unchanged.
`npm run build --workspace=server` (tsc -b) exits 0 and produces server/dist/index.js.
With Atlas reachable, `npm run seed` clears and reseeds all collections and bootstraps the admin, exiting 0.

With the server running: GET /api/health returns {"status":"ok"}; GET /api/league returns the full League JSON with 6 teams and 4 leaderboards and no _id fields; POST /api/teams without a token returns 401; POST /api/auth/login with ADMIN_USERNAME + the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD returns {token,user}; the same POST /api/teams with a Bearer token returns 200/201.
No secret VALUES appear in any committed file or log; server/README.md references ADMIN_PASSWORD by location only.
verification: `npm install` (root) then `npm run build --workspace=shared` — exits 0; confirm shared/dist/index.d.ts exists.
`npm run build --workspace=server` — tsc -b exits 0; confirm server/dist/index.js exists.
`npm run seed` (root) — exits 0 with reseed + admin-bootstrap logs (key names only). ATLAS CONTINGENCY if the connection is refused.

Start `node server/dist/index.js`; run the curl sequence (health, league, unauthenticated POST -> 401, login, authenticated POST -> 200/201); stop the server. ATLAS CONTINGENCY applies to every DB-touching check — report blocked, never passed-when-skipped.
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. Atlas was reachable — NOTHING is Atlas-blocked; all DB-dependent checks passed live.

CONTRACT FOR FEAT-002 (client refactor):

Base URL: all endpoints are under '/api'. The client api/client.ts BASE_URL must be '/api' and request() paths must be the part AFTER /api (e.g. request('/league'), never request('/api/league')). getReportUrl(id) must return `${BASE_URL}/reports/${id}` = '/api/reports/:id' (NOT '/api/api/...').

Auth / token:
- POST /api/auth/login  body {username,password} -> 200 {token, user:{username}} (LoginResponse). 400 if either field empty; 401 {error:'Invalid credentials'} for unknown-user OR bad-password (identical message).
- GET /api/auth/me  (Bearer token) -> 200 {username} (AdminUser). 401 on missing/malformed/invalid/expired token.
- JWT payload is { sub: username }, 7d expiry. Middleware sets req.user={username}.
- STORE THE RAW JWT STRING in localStorage under key 'bowling-league.token' (NOT a user object). Send as header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Old key to clean up on load: 'bowling-league.auth'.
- request() must surface HTTP status on thrown errors so AuthContext can clear the token ONLY on 401/403 and keep it on network/5xx.

Public GET endpoints (no auth): GET /api/health -> {status:'ok'}; GET /api/league -> full League (503 if unseeded, no _id fields); GET /api/teams; GET /api/teams/:id (404); GET /api/bowlers; GET /api/schedule (sorted by week); GET /api/results; GET /api/leaderboards (insertion order, NO sort); GET /api/reports -> WeeklyReport[] (sorted season,week); GET /api/reports/:id -> streams PDF inline (Content-Disposition: inline).

Protected writes (Bearer token required, 401 without):
- POST/PUT/DELETE /api/teams and /api/teams/:id  (PUT/DELETE by domain id)
- POST/PUT/DELETE /api/bowlers and /api/bowlers/:id (by domain id)
- POST/PUT/DELETE /api/schedule and /api/schedule/:week (by week integer)
- POST/PUT/DELETE /api/results and /api/results/:id (PUT/DELETE by Mongo _id hex; 400 on bad hex)
- PUT /api/leaderboards  (full-array replace, preserves order; value may be number|string)
- PUT /api/league/meta   (body {season,currentWeek,currentWeekDate,split})
- POST /api/reports      (multipart/form-data: file field 'file' PDF-only max 10MB, plus season/week/date; use fetch directly with FormData + Bearer, DO NOT set JSON Content-Type) -> 201 WeeklyReport
- DELETE /api/reports/:id (idempotent, 204)

Server errors return JSON {error}. Multer: oversize -> 413, wrong field -> 400.

Dev proxy: server listens on port 4000 (config.port default). client/vite.config.ts needs server.proxy '/api' -> http://localhost:4000, changeOrigin:true (additive edit). The '/api/reports/:id' anchor href and FormData upload both go through this same proxy — keep them relative, never hardcode the backend host.

Seed data: copied VERBATIM into server/src/seed.ts and reviewed against client/src/data/league.ts (6 teams, 18 bowlers, 3 schedule, 3 results incl. awaySeries:0 & single-element awayGames & differing array lengths, 4 leaderboards with two 'High Average' Male/Female, meta season '2026 Lakers' currentWeek 3). FEAT-002 OWNS deletion of client/src/data/league.ts and client/src/types.ts — both still present and untouched here.

Env: DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME(=admin), ADMIN_PASSWORD were generated and appended to root atlas-credentials.env (gitignored via *.env). The generated ADMIN_PASSWORD is in that file under the ADMIN_PASSWORD key — never printed/committed. No secret values appear in server/README.md.

No git repo exists (no .git) — nothing was committed. shared/dist and server/dist are built and present.
